title: Field vs Method Borrow
goal: Modify a struct field directly to avoid borrowing the entire struct.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Borrow Checking

hints: Calling inv.add_gold() borrows all of inv mutably via &mut self.
Borrow the label field directly instead of borrowing the whole struct, then modify inv.gold directly.
explanation: Borrowing &inv.label borrows only the label field, leaving inv.gold available for mutation. Modifying inv.gold += 10 succeeds because Rust tracks field borrows independently. Calling inv.add_gold(10) or borrowing &inv borrows the entire struct, which conflicts with any existing reference to a field and triggers E0502. Trying inv.label without & attempts to move the String out of a reference, causing E0507.
